column1: # HDD HK1 demo payload catalogue (lab/rehearsal only).
# Tab-separated, one payload per line: id <TAB> group <TAB> payload
#   M1..M6  the six mandated SQL-injection payloads (docs/SPEC.md C4.1 / E1.1)
#   B1..B6  the six auth-bypass forms named in docs/COLLAB.md (HK1 assignment)
# This file is read by lab/demo/attack.ps1 and lab/demo/attack.sh, and parsed by
# scripts/test/*.test.mjs which checks the mandated values against docs/SPEC.md.
# Do not add other attack classes here: the demo only covers SQL injection on a
# login form and only targets operator-authorised hosts (targets.allow).
# Payloads must not contain tab or newline characters (one per line).
# The payloads are sent exactly as written, including spacing.
